subject.title: fix(qqbot): bound gateway websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should QQBot unconditionally cap opening handshakes at 30 seconds, accepting reconnect attempts when a legitimate gateway or proxy takes longer?
rationale: Source and live transport proof establish that the cap fixes the permanent connecting state, but code inspection cannot determine the intended QQBot tolerance for unusually slow real gateways or proxies.

options.title: Accept the 30-second cap
options.body: Confirm the sibling-aligned fixed limit, rebase as needed around the payload PR, and merge with both constructor constraints covered.

options.title: Choose another fixed limit
options.body: Have the QQBot owner select a different bounded value and update the focused expectation and transport proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the behavior change
options.body: Leave the current unbounded behavior in place until real QQBot latency evidence supports a fail-closed threshold.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second cap
recommendation.body: Confirm the sibling-aligned fixed limit, rebase as needed around the payload PR, and merge with both constructor constraints covered.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged QQBot channel and its gateway architecture, making them the strongest available owner for this transport-policy decision.
